newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to press Russia on missiles for Iran.
newsitem.headline: Israel to press Russia on missiles for Iran.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Tuesday Israel planned to press Russia not to help Iran develop ballistic missiles.

"We view any assistance given by Russia to Iran to develop ballistic missiles as something that is inherently endangering the very future of Israel and we believe it also endangers the future and the interests of Russia," Netanyahu said.
"This is something that we will let the Russian government know in no uncertain terms," he said in a speech to U.S. Jewish leaders.

The Los Angeles Times reported last month that Washington had issued a diplomatic warning to Moscow about Russian assistance to Iran's missile programme that could threaten U.S. troops in Saudi Arabia, several Gulf allies and Israel.

Quoting senior Clinton administration officials, the newspaper said intelligence reports indicated that Russia recently transferred to Iran technology for the Russian SS-4 missile, which has a range almost three times greater than that of any missile now in Iran's arsenal.
Israel, widely reported to have its own nuclear warheads and missiles to deliver them, has accused Islamic Iran of seeking the destruction of the Jewish state.
